maria_finance: FYI — Borealis Health billed invoice BOR-5582 has a 3/24 usage spike of 475,000 tokens (~$14,250). Ops traced to an internal test harness that accidentally used prod keys. Customer asking for relief. Proposing 50% credit = $7,125 as a one-time accommodation.

alex_support: Confirmed. Trace in FIN-8301 shows canary-suite v1.4 looped for ~90m after a config rollback. Client-id: canary-borealis-77. No other traffic patterns indicate prod usage.

devon_fp&a: Accounting: book to One-off credits GL 6102. Amount <$10k so Finance Manager can approve per delegation. Need a short memo for month close describing operational error and strategic rationale (retain customer on trial).

sam_legal: No contractual barrier. Recommend credit memo language: "Issued as a one-time customer accommodation; not an admission of liability; non-precedent setting." I can draft and attach.

billing-bot: System note: Manual credits <=$10,000 can be posted by Finance Manager; attach ticket FIN-8301 and GL 6102.

maria_finance: Approving $7,125 credit. I'll post credit memo, update invoice BOR-5582, and tag FIN-8301. Will include legal language. Closing loop. :white_check_mark:
